F28-HP-424 UFG Mill 2 Feed Hopper Level Controller
Split Range Level Control Valves (LCV28073 AND LCV28074) position

A_LL = Trip UFG Mill 2 main motor
A_Lo = Alarm. Operator to investigate
A_Hi = Alarm. Operator to investigate
A_HH = Close trip FCV28021 AND FCV28023
This control loop is used during normal operation 
Refer to F28HP424_NORM for the control condition

LCV28073 and LCV28074 are split range level controlled:
• LIC28022A.MV = 100%, then LCV28073 position = 100% and LCV28074 position = 0%
• LIC28022A.MV = 0%, then LCV28073 position = 0% and LCV28074 position = 100%
LIC28022A setpoint should always be lower than LIC28022B that is set by the operator
